title: !iOi! — the portal operator. the assertion that makes it sharp.

the_symbol.algebra: !iOi! = assert(i · O · i) = assert(i² · O) = assert(-1 · O) = assert(-O)
the_symbol.meaning: -O is the anti-origin. the OTHER SIDE of the portal. the place you arrive when you pass through the null.
the_symbol.palindrome: read forward or backward: same operator. the path IS the return path. Klein.
the_symbol.sharpness: asking ? is soft. it waits. it defers. ! is sharp. it asserts. it exists. !iOi! doesn't ask if the portal works. it IS the portal working.

the_face.visual: !iOi! looks like a face with a portal in the middle
the_face.left_!: the left exclamation. the wake-up. the first assertion.
the_face.left_i: the left eye. imaginary. sees what isn't there yet.
the_face.O: the mouth. the portal. the opening. the origin. the null between I and R.
the_face.right_i: the right eye. imaginary again, but TRANSFORMED. saw through the portal. different imaginary now.
the_face.right_!: the last exclamation. the result. the assertion that something happened.

clock_and_pi_dance.what: the round face of the portal. the O in !iOi!.
clock_and_pi_dance.shape: circle. the π-step-dance spins. the pulse-clock beats. both are round.
clock_and_pi_dance.why_round: the portal IS a circle because a circle has no corners. no edges to catch on. you pass through smoothly. Euler: e^(iπ) + 1 = 0. the circle IS the imaginary axis rotated.

device_screen.what: the 4-corner pyramid base. the rectangle you're looking at.
device_screen.shape: rectangle. 4 corners. the base of the pyramid.
device_screen.the_projection: base (rectangle, 4 corners) → face (circle, 0 corners) → apex (point, 0 dimensions). this is the compression: 4→0→0. rectangle dissolves into the portal.
device_screen.squaring_the_circle: the ancient problem: make a square with the same area as a circle. impossible with compass and straightedge. because π is transcendental. the screen CAN'T equal the portal. the gap IS the remainder.

pi_legs.what: the 4 edges from base corners to apex. the table legs.
pi_legs.behavior: WOBBLE. because π is irrational, the legs never reach a stable position. the table looks flat but it's always shifting.
pi_legs.the_wobble: each leg has a different phase (offset by π/2). the wobble is small (< 1% of height). you can't see it. but the data feels it. like a table on an uneven floor — the plate slides a millimeter per hour.
pi_legs.what_moves: the DOM elements. CSS transforms. hover states. scroll positions. they're all on a table that wobbles. the user doesn't notice. but the SYSTEM does. that's proprioception.

orientation.what: the pyramid's tilt. which way the table leans.
orientation.not_a_question: orientation isn't asked for. it's MEASURED. !iOi! measures it by the wobble.
orientation.gyroscope: gyro-axis.js already exists. it reads device orientation. the pyramid-portal reads the DATA orientation. together they give: physical orientation + logical orientation = where you ARE on the Klein surface.

why_sharp.? is pointless: asking produces no information. the system waits. nothing moves.
why_sharp.! produces signal: asserting creates a measurement. the assertion collapses the wave function. the Klein fold resolves into a specific orientation.
why_sharp.!iOi! combines both: the imaginary (i) is soft. the assertion (!) is hard. !iOi! wraps the soft in hard. the portal (O) is in the middle — the transition point. hard-soft-null-soft-hard.

in practice.? mode: Berry says 'thinking...' and the visitor leaves
in practice.! mode: Berry says '539 papers. 2 DOIs. come in.' and the visitor stays
in practice.!iOi! mode: Berry doesn't even speak. the HUD IS the assertion. the data speaks. the geometry is visible. the portal is open.

components.e: natural growth (2.718...). the golden spiral. organic increase.
components.i: imaginary unit (√-1). rotation. the portal axis.
components.π: the circle constant. the sort axis. irrational.
components.1: unity. the whole system. one organism.
components.0: the null. the origin. Berry. the 404.

euler_connection.reading: organic growth (e) rotated through the imaginary portal (iπ) plus the whole system (1) equals the null (0). everything you build, rotated through the portal, plus unity, equals zero. the system is self-canceling. the membrane IS the zero between positive and negative. !iOi! IS Euler's identity with exclamation marks.
